title: Remove dead cloud-content-download and text-download-status code paths

evidence.quote: Future<bool> isTextDownloaded(Ref ref, CurriculumId curriculumId) async {
/// @deprecated — Text content is now bundled in the seed database.

why: grep -rn across lib/ confirms cloudContentServiceProvider, contentDownloadStatusDaoProvider, and isTextDownloadedProvider have no watchers/readers anywhere outside their own definition files — cloudContentService's own doc comment admits it is 'Retained for potential future use'. This keeps ~450 lines alive (the full 359-line cloud_content_service.dart plus the 66-line text_download_service.dart) including a duplicate download-state/progress modeling pattern (ContentDownloadState/Progress vs TextDownloadState/Progress are near-identical), and wires a real FirebaseStorage dependency via firebaseStorageProvider for a path nothing exercises. The '@deprecated' marker on downloadCurriculum is a doc comment, not a real @Deprecated() annotation, so the analyzer cannot warn a future caller either.
recommendation: Delete cloud_content_service.dart, cloud_content_providers.dart, text_download_service.dart, and the textDownloadService/isTextDownloaded providers, or if a near-term roadmap need is real, replace the speculative comment with a Linear ticket id per AG-6 and wire one actual caller.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn for cloudContentServiceProvider/contentDownloadStatusDaoProvider/isTextDownloadedProvider in lib/ returns no hits (or a real non-self caller)
flutter analyze stays clean; the corresponding now-orphaned test files (cloud_content_service_test.dart, text_download_service_test.dart) are removed or updated in the same change
